g.title: CRPS_QSP
g.text: Neurogenic Inflammation · Autoimmunity · Sympatho-Afferent Coupling · Tissue Hypoxia · Central Sensitization · Cortical Reorganization · Disuse-Bone Loop · Drug PK/PD
